steps.name: Given user is on tha dashboard page
When admin click the  course moderation module
And admin using the filter option
And admin select the "published" published option
And admin click the navigation icon

And admin select the reject button in displayed details
And admin verify rejected  courses is removed from the table
And admin select the "under_review" underreview option
And admin select the reject button
And admin verify rejected  courses is removed again from underreview the table
And admin select the publish option
